summary_en: EDION Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 2.5 million shares (2.36% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 from November 10-16, 2026, to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, EDION Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 2,500,000 shares of its own stock (representing 2.36% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total amount of 5.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including block trades via ToSTNeT-3, during the period from November 10 to November 16, 2026.

The company stated that the purpose of this share buyback is to enhance capital efficiency and provide greater returns to shareholders while enabling flexible capital allocation. As noted in the disclosure, the actual execution of orders may be partially or wholly suspended depending on market conditions. The company separately announced plans to conduct an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) transaction on an aggregate basis for 5.0 billion yen in value using pre-announced block trading, with details provided in a separate press release of the same date.
